speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
text: asked the Minister for National Development from 2015 to 2018, what is the average sale price for land sold to (i) private housing developers and (ii) HDB for development of public housing in mature housing estates, respectively.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: For public housing developments, state land is sold to the Housing and Development Board (HDB) at the market value assessed by the Chief Valuer.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The valuation is done in accordance with market conditions and established valuation principles.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Land for public housing has a lower valuation, compared to land zoned for private housing.
